title: NetherFortressCompass
description:
打开下界传送门遗址箱子可获得下界要塞指南针， 补完遗迹去到下界后，该指南针可指向最近的下界要塞。     
Opening the Nether Portal Ruins chest grants a Nether Fortress Compass. After completing the ruins and going to the Nether, this compass will point to the nearest Nether Fortress.
body:
# 主要功能介绍
你还在为找不到下界要塞而苦恼？本模组提供最丝滑且符合游戏流程的引导，探索主世界时，在下界传送门遗址里找到箱子并打开，即可获得一枚特殊的「下界要塞指南针」。模组会根据该遗址在你世界中的位置，自动在下界对应区域寻找最近的下界要塞，并在要塞附近放置磁石，将指南针与之绑定。当你补完遗迹、进入下界后，只需手持这枚指南针，即可沿指针方向前往离你最近的要塞，省去盲目乱逛的时间。每个遗址箱子只会触发一次，进度会随存档保存，适合生存探险与速通下界资源。
# 机制 + 联机说明
每个遗址箱子仅触发一次，进度写入存档；联机时需服务端与客户端均安装本模组方可正常游玩。

# Main Features

Still struggling to find a Nether Fortress? This mod provides a smooth and immersive guidance system that fits naturally into Minecraft’s progression. While exploring the Overworld, you can discover a chest inside a Ruined Portal. Opening it grants a special **Nether Fortress Compass**.

Based on the location of that Ruined Portal in your world, the mod automatically searches the corresponding Nether region for the nearest Nether Fortress, then places a lodestone near the fortress and binds the compass to it.

After repairing the portal and entering the Nether, simply hold the compass in your hand and follow its direction to reach the nearest fortress, saving you from wandering aimlessly across the Nether. Each Ruined Portal chest can only trigger once, and all progress is saved with the world, making the mod suitable for both survival exploration and speedrunning Nether progression.

# Mechanics & Multiplayer

Each Ruined Portal chest can only be triggered once, and all progress is stored in the world save.
For multiplayer, both the server and all clients must have this mod installed for proper gameplay.
